title: eval-harness: add CI hooks for prompt-set regression gating + eval metrics integration
author: Priya Nair
description:
Motivation: Prevent prompt-set regressions from reaching production by making eval-harness results a first-class CI gating mechanism. This PR wires up two things: 1) lightweight CI hooks that run targeted prompt-set regression checks on changed prompt files and model manifests, and 2) an integration that uploads eval metrics (accuracy/rouge/embedding-similarity) to the centralized metrics service so gating decisions are auditable.

What this PR does: - Adds a new GitHub Actions workflow (ci/eval-regression-check.yml) that triggers on PRs touching eval/ prompts, prompt_sets/, or model manifests. The workflow runs a cached subset of the eval-harness (fast mode) to compute delta metrics vs the pinned baseline and fails the job when regressions exceed thresholds configured per prompt_set. - Introduces a small eval-ci hook library (python) that standardizes threshold parsing, baseline lookup, and result reporting to the CI steps. - Hooks the eval-runner to emit structured eval metrics (jsonl) and uploads them to the internal metrics ingestion endpoint for lineage and dashboards. - Adds documentation and a short runbook for triaging failures (docs/eval/ci-gates.md).

Checklist: - [x] Design doc (linked in description) - [x] Unit tests for eval-ci hook functions - [x] Integration test in workflow (fast eval mode) - [x] Metrics upload tested against staging ingestion - [x] Docs and runbook included

Testing notes: The workflow was exercised on this branch with multiple model variants. One flaky test (test_eval_runner_cli) failed intermittently and was retried; CI summary below includes the rerun. Threshold configuration is conservative by default and can be tuned per-prompt-set via eval/config/thresholds.yaml. For larger runs, the gating workflow posts a comment with a short summary and a link to the full evaluation artifact in S3.

Backward compatibility: This is additive and disabled for large/full evals by default. Consumers can opt-in to strict gating via repository labels or Linear tickets.

Rollout plan: Merge to main, monitor alerts for 72 hours. If noise is high, we will flip to a soft-fail mode that reports regressions but does not block merges.
